item.title: No Ketchup in My Kitchen
item.description: Not every meatloaf needs ketchup. This Turkey Mushroom Meatloaf is cooked in pomegranate molasses and topped with roast whole tomatoes.

item.title: There are Options in Life
item.description: We’re apartment hunting, he’s following his filmmaking dreams (finally!), I’m learning how to collaborate with new managers at the job, and we’re too stressed. In between each cardamon bite of these Date, Walnut and Sesame Seed Scone is a reminder of how we’re still doing thankfully well amid the chaos.

item.title: #SmoothieNumbers 33: Minty Wtrmln Wtr and Blueberry
item.description: All thanks to Dad for influencing my recent cravings for watermelon. But in a New York minute, I can drink a bottle of Wtrlm Wtr. In five minutes, frozen blueberries, Wtrlm Wtr Water (any flavor) and mint leaves can be blitz into a refreshing smoothie.

item.title: Appetizing Thoughts: Short and Sweet
item.description: As I pause my food writing for a brief moment of time to shift my focus on other areas in my life, I’m feeding my stress with a sweet open-face sandwich of honey ricotta cheese, figs, and shaved chocolate.

item.title: I Live Today
item.description: A healthier twist of the classic Ceasar Salad made with curly kale, black eye peas, and corn with a caesar dressing made with anchovy paste and yogurt. Finish salad by tossing cornbread croutons.
